overloads.semanticRole: Displays a modal confirmation dialog (note icon, message, OK and Cancel buttons, with optional custom button titles) and sets the OK system variable according to the user's choice.

constraints: Must not be called from a form/object method handling the On Activate or On Deactivate form events (causes an endless loop).
Sets the OK system variable to 1 if the user validates (OK/Enter) or 0 if the user cancels.
